$comment: The greeting a runtime built on runtime-protocol 1.0.1 sends, captured from that codec before it was deleted and frozen here on purpose: these bytes are what an old binary still on somebody's machine puts on the wire, and a test proving a Mango Protocol 1 peer closes such a connection with 4426 is only worth anything if the input is the real thing. Never regenerate them - there is nothing left to regenerate them from, and rewriting them by hand would turn the assertion into a tautology about the build under test. `line` is the stdio record without its terminator; `chunks` is the same frame as the base64 of the WebSocket messages it becomes, which is one, since it fits.
